title: GOF seizes 185 saplings suspected of being smuggled from Thailand
summary: KOTA BARU: The General Operations Force (GOF) seized 185 saplings of various types suspected of being smuggled from Thailand via an ungazetted route in Jeram Perdah, Pasir Mas, today.
